title: AI Automation SaaS Platform
summary: A multi-tenant platform that lets teams build AI-driven workflows — connecting data sources, LLM prompts, and third-party APIs without writing code.
overview: Built to let small teams automate repetitive operational work — support triage, report generation, and data enrichment — through configurable AI workflows.
architecture: Next.js frontend, a Node API layer, PostgreSQL for tenant data, and a queue-based worker that executes workflow steps against the OpenAI API.
challenges: Keeping workflow runs reliable under rate limits
Designing a schema flexible enough for arbitrary workflow steps
results: Reduced manual report-building time in testing by an estimated 70%, with workflows completing reliably across retries.

title: TechSphere E-commerce Platform
summary: A full-featured storefront with catalog management, cart, checkout, and an admin dashboard for inventory and orders.
overview: A tech-products storefront built to practice production-style commerce flows: auth, cart persistence, and order lifecycle.
architecture: React SPA consuming a Node/Express REST API, with MySQL for products, orders, and users, and role-based access for the admin panel.
challenges: Keeping cart state consistent across sessions
Designing an admin dashboard non-technical staff could use
results: Delivered a working checkout flow and admin dashboard covering the full order lifecycle from cart to fulfillment.

title: Food Ordering System
summary: A desktop ordering system for a campus food stall — menu management, order tracking, and receipt printing.
overview: A capstone-style project built to model real ordering operations for a small food business, from order entry to receipt.
architecture: VB.NET desktop client with a local MySQL database, using stored procedures for order totals and inventory deduction.
challenges: Handling concurrent order entry without double-counting stock
Designing a receipt layout matching real printer hardware
results: Delivered a working system used in classroom demos, cutting manual order tallying time significantly.
